_meta.description: Exercise bank built from @the_runstrong_coach's free online exercise library (names, categories, tiers) plus the 43 'featured' exercises seen with sets/reps in his reels. Default sets/reps, equipment, intensity and unilateral flags on library entries are auto-assigned, not his. Videos live on his site at video_url.
_meta.plyo_tiers: From his library: light < medium < ping (fast, reactive) / deep (big landings). Intensity mapping is an assumption.
_meta.app_added: Entries with source "app" were added by the app for easy-day Upper body sessions (push-up, band row, band pull-apart); they are standard moves, not from the coach.

featured.name: Drop jump
featured.rest: 20 s between reps, 60 s between sets
featured.cue: Step off, land with both feet, floor is lava: minimize ground contact. Height is not the goal.

featured.name: Split-stance drop jump
featured.cue: Land in a split stance and rebound fast.

featured.name: Pogos
featured.cue: Stiff ankles, quick bounce, whole-foot contact.

featured.name: Single-leg pogos
featured.cue: Quiet, springy contacts; keep the knee soft but stiff ankle.

featured.name: Split exchange pogos
featured.cue: Switch legs in the air each contact while moving forward.

featured.name: Alternating single-leg hopping
featured.cue: Build up to it; arguably the best plyo for running efficiency.

featured.name: Band-assisted single-leg hops
featured.cue: Use the band to keep contacts fast while learning the pattern.

featured.name: Dumbbell jump
featured.cue: Light dumbbells, max intent, stick the landing.

featured.name: Skips, gallops and bounds
featured.cue: Long reps so you actually find the rhythm.

featured.name: Slalom jumps
featured.cue: Side to side with quick contacts.

featured.name: Skater bounds
featured.cue: Push laterally, stick each landing.

featured.name: Slant board lateral hops
featured.cue: Builds ankle stability against rolling.

featured.name: Back squat
featured.cue: RPE 7, crisp reps, never to failure.

featured.name: Trap bar deadlift
featured.cue: Heavy and fast off the floor; doubles as core work.

featured.name: Bulgarian split squat
featured.cue: Feet close = more glute; farther = more hamstring.

featured.name: Sled backpedal
featured.cue: Low impact quad work.

featured.name: Romanian deadlift
featured.cue: Hip hinge, hamstrings loaded from the hip.

featured.name: Landmine RDL
featured.cue: The landmine arc naturally teaches the hinge.

featured.name: Single-leg landmine RDL
featured.cue: Drive your back heel to the ceiling. Slow and intentional.

featured.name: Slider RDL
featured.cue: Back toe stays on the slider for balance so you can load more.

featured.name: Nordic curl
featured.cue: Hard cap: 3 sets x 3 reps. Don't start here if new.

featured.name: Sprinter hamstring curl
featured.cue: Hamstring trained from a flexed hip, like running.

featured.name: Physioball hamstring oscillations
featured.cue: Rapid contract-relax cycles.

featured.name: Barbell calf raise
featured.cue: Press through the big toe.

featured.name: Single-leg calf raise
featured.cue: Full range, press through the big toe.

featured.name: Runner-stance calf raise
featured.cue: Opposite knee driven up like a stride.

featured.name: Bent-knee calf raise (soleus)
featured.cue: Soleus does most of the work in distance running.

featured.name: Angled / slant board calf raise
featured.cue: Builds 360-degree foot and ankle resilience.

featured.name: Farmer carry toe walk
featured.cue: On the balls of your feet; play with the angles.

featured.name: Big toe overcoming iso
featured.cue: Press the big toe down as hard as possible.

featured.name: Tib bar raises
featured.cue: Front of shin; controlled tempo.

featured.name: Banded hip flexor overcoming iso
featured.cue: Drive the knee up hard against the band.

featured.name: Banded sprint-angle hip flexor
featured.cue: Lean like a sprint start and punch the knee through.

featured.name: Reverse hyper hip flexor
featured.cue: Lift legs from hanging using the hip flexors.

featured.name: Band hip flexor (lying)
featured.cue: Lying on back, band on the foot, drive knee to chest.

featured.name: Dynamic rocking hip flexor
featured.cue: Rock back on the bench and lift both legs.

featured.name: Copenhagen plank
featured.cue: Progress lever length over weeks.

featured.name: Long-range monster walks
featured.cue: Extra volume only off-season and early in-season.

featured.name: FFESS oscillation
featured.cue: Front-foot-elevated split squat, quick small bounces at the bottom.

featured.name: Split squat overcoming iso
featured.cue: Push max effort into fixed pins. High force, almost no fatigue.

featured.name: Overcoming hamstring iso (roller)
featured.cue: Heel drives down into the roller as hard as possible.

featured.name: Split-stance ankle iso
featured.cue: Rear heel raised, hold strong. Good for nagging spots.

featured.name: Split-stance iso hold
featured.cue: Low split stance hold. Used in return weeks.
